OUAT Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for OUAT Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for OUAT Guest Faculty Recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the OUAT Guest Faculty recruitment is scheduled for 30 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for the Guest Faculty post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Minimum 2nd Class Bachelor's Degree in Agriculture and allied sciences with at least 55% marks/ equivalent OGPA, and a Minimum 2nd Class Master's Degree in the concerned subject with at least 55% marks/ equivalent OGPA.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any age limit for the Guest Faculty position at OUAT?
faq.answer: Yes, the maximum age limit for the Guest Faculty post is 64 years as of 31 August 2026. No minimum age limit is specified.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for OUAT Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for both General/OBC and SC/ST categories is Rs. 500. This fee needs to be paid by the candidates applying for the post.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Guest Faculty post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies announced for the Guest Faculty position in Agribusiness Management at OUAT.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for the Guest Faculty at OUAT?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs 1200/- per class, with a maximum limit of 30 classes per month per teacher. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Guest Faculty recruitment at OUAT will be based on a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview with all required documents.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the Odisha University of Agriculture and Technology (OUAT) campus in Bhubaneswar, Odisha. The exact venue details are in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original educational certificates, mark sheets, experience certificates (if any), category certificates (if applicable), and a valid ID proof. Self-attested photocopies of these documents are also required.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the Guest Faculty position at OUAT is a contractual job. The duration and terms of the contract will be as per the university's policy and the official notification.
